_docs: Approved-library registry (task #4). Spliced into tech_specs/build context and enforced by designlint.py: 'banned' entries are lint ERRORS; when 'allowed' is non-empty, any other third-party SPM dependency is a WARNING (error in runtime.design_lint_strict). System frameworks (SwiftUI, SwiftData, Foundation, ...) are always fine and never need listing.

banned.name: Alamofire
banned.why: URLSession covers every need here; no third-party networking.

banned.name: SwiftyJSON
banned.why: Codable is the standard; unmaintained-style JSON wrappers add risk.

banned.name: realm
banned.why: SwiftData/GRDB are the approved persistence choices.

notes: Prefer system frameworks first: URLSession for networking, SwiftData for persistence, Swift Charts for charts, OSLog for logging. A new third-party dependency needs a one-line justification in tech_specs.
